verdict.rationale: uv ships explicit CI/headless support: official `astral-sh/setup-uv` GitHub Action for installing/caching, non-interactive `uv run`/`uv sync`/`uv lock` commands, deterministic lockfiles for reproducible builds, JSON-formatted output (`uv version --output-format json`) for scripting, and `uv self update`/`uv cache clean` for maintenance in automated pipelines. Community feedback confirms it 'just works' in scripted/server contexts (uv-comm-7, uv-comm-10) though one user reports Docker friction (uv-comm-16), a caveat rather than a full contradiction. missing for 10: independent CI-benchmark reports beyond GitHub Actions, and resolution of the noted Docker integration friction.
